qualification_reason: Peterson Zeyer Law is a specialized bankruptcy practice focused on Chapter 7/13 relief and closely related bankruptcy-client needs such as wage garnishment and credit rebuilding. The site does not present several materially different main legal services sharing one general conversation, so there is no campaign-fit separate-service architecture problem.
campaign_notes: Live-site review shows the firm works in bankruptcy day-in and day-out and describes itself as a leading Chapter 7/13 filer. Navigation and supporting pages remain within the same bankruptcy client journey. This is a focused niche practice rather than the multi-service consolidated architecture targeted by the campaign. No contact enrichment performed.

service_gap_evidence.validation_method: live homepage + attorneys page + garnishment page + ICP gate
service_gap_evidence.notes: Single primary legal conversation; not a multi-service shared-page opportunity.
